name: Commandments
overview: The commandments given by the LORD, as revealed in Exodus, establish a foundational call to exclusive devotion and obedience to God, prohibiting idolatry and emphasizing remembrance of His mighty deliverance from Egypt. These precepts serve as enduring ordinances to be kept faithfully across generations, marking God's covenant people by His law written on their hearts and minds. The commands underscore God's holiness and justice, highlighting His jealous nature and the serious consequences of disobedience, while inviting believers to live in reverent obedience as a response to His redemptive acts.
